title: Kazakh–Dzungar Wars
text: The Kazakh–Dzungar Wars were a series of military conflicts between the Kazakh jüzes and the Dzungar Khanate lasting from the 17th to the mid-18th century. The conflict between the Kazakhs and the Oirats started from the first half of the 16th-century, all the way down to the later half of the 18th-century. Both nations later fought against the Qing dynasty, particularly in the First Sino–Kazakh War of the Ten Great Campaigns.
